verdict_reason: Delta over 00497199..18f655ca, 2 commits, 18 files, 209(+)/134(-) (`git diff 00497199..HEAD --stat`). (1) 0c2e56ef: docs-only -- adds the PR-gate verdict for 00497199 and deletes the consumed 448d365e verdict (both under specs/releases/0.4.7/verdicts/), plus three test-only assertion fixes never exercised while CI was locked -- normalize Rich's box-wrapped usage-error output before asserting option names present (tests/contract/test_doctor_without_an_instance.py), filter copy-drift findings by POSIX path since a Windows finding path carries backslashes (tests/contract/test_copy_drift_scoped_law.py), and assert the telemetry backstop resolves outside the operator's <home-dir>/.dadaia store root rather than outside the home directory outright, since a Windows tmp_path lives under the home directory (tests/contract/test_telemetry_store_backstop.py). No production code touched by this commit; re-verified, matches its own prior delta approval, no new finding. (2) 18f655ca: production change confined to 4 files -- the git port method `first_parent(sha) -> str | None` is replaced by `parents(sha) -> tuple[str, ...]` in dadaia_workspace/features/chokepoints/verdict.py (ShaSource protocol) and push_gate.py (ObjectSource protocol); the adapter (dadaia_workspace/infrastructure/git_objects.py) implements it as `git rev-list --parents -n 1 <sha>`, splits stdout and drops the first field (the sha itself). Guard placement verified by direct read: `if not sha or not _SHA_SHAPE_RE.match(sha): return ()` runs BEFORE `_run(...)` is ever called -- an option-shaped sha (e.g. `--upload-pack=evil`) is rejected before any subprocess spawn, confirmed by test_parents_of_an_option_shaped_sha_is_empty_never_raises. `_run` uses `subprocess.run(args, ...)` with args as a list and no `shell=True` anywhere in the module (grep confirmed) -- no shell-injection surface, same pattern as every other method on this adapter (list_tree_paths, commit_exists, object_type all share the identical shape-then-list-argv defense, CWE-88 second-layer, per the module's own docstrings). `dadaia_workspace/cli/commands/ci.py::_first_parent_sha` now delegates to `parents(...)[0] if parents else None` -- same public contract (str | None), same delegation-to-one-reader invariant (re-asserted by tests/unit/infrastructure/test_honesty_residue.py, updated to check for `.parents(` instead of the old method name). `live_verdict_shas` (verdict.py) traced by hand and against its own new/changed unit tests: for a linear (single-parent) head_sha, `parents(head)` returns a 1-tuple, `parents[1:]` is empty, so the merged-lines addition is a no-op and the resulting set is unchanged from before (head, first-parent, integration-tip) -- confirmed by the pre-existing dedupe/drop tests still passing unmodified. For a merge commit, the new code adds (a) every direct parent of head (previously only the first parent was included) and (b) the first parent of each additional ("merged") parent -- verified against test_live_shas_cover_the_verdict_a_merge_commit_just_consumed and the real-git adapter test test_parents_of_a_merge_commit_lists_both_lines_first_parent_first (both new, both read and both pass). This closes a real false-positive: before this fix, develop's tip right after a feature->develop merge (or main's right after a ship merge) did not include either the merged branch's own tip (the PR head sha the security-reviewer verdict may also name, per dd-gitflow-default's two-hop rule) or that tip's first parent (the actual reviewed sha the verdict's metrics.commit_sha names) in its live set, so SPEC-DOC-044 wrongly flagged the verdict the merge had just consumed as stale. The walk is bounded to depth 1 from head_sha's own direct parents (no recursion beyond one merged-line hop), so it cannot resurrect an unrelated, older verdict buried deeper in history -- a verdict becomes live only by being the actual PR head or the actual reviewed sha of the specific merge that produced the current head, both facts read from the real git commit graph (immutable, not attacker-suppliable via a dropped file), not from any file content. No injection, no authorization bypass, no expansion of trust beyond the two-hop rule dd-gitflow-default already documents; a correctness fix to make the existing rule hold at the integration-branch edge, not a new grant. All fakes/tests across contract and unit suites (test_every_block_carries_a_fix.py, test_push_gate_wiring.py, test_push_branch_policy.py, test_push_denylist_scan.py, test_push_specs_canon_scan.py, test_doctor_stale_verdicts.py) were mechanically renamed first_parent->parents with equivalent return shapes (None -> (), single value -> 1-tuple) -- read in full, no behavior drift, no path/secret introduced. Targeted suite: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/features/chokepoints tests/unit/infrastructure/test_git_object_reader.py tests/unit/features/specs/test_doctor_stale_verdicts.py tests/integration/cli/test_cli_ci_verdict_check.py -q -p no:cacheprovider` -> 216 passed, 0 failed. Leak grep `git diff 00497199..HEAD | grep -nE '<home-dir>/|<home-dir>/|IPv4-shape'` -> 1 raw hit, inside the ship verdict's own verdict_reason prose (the e8a0242c handoff file added by 18f655ca) quoting `<home-dir>` as a redaction placeholder within its own already-approved scan description -- not a real path, not a new disclosure; matches the exclusion the review instructions named explicitly (verdict-prose placeholder hits are not findings). No production dependency, poetry.lock, pyproject.toml, or .github/ file touched anywhere in this delta (`git diff 00497199..HEAD --stat -- poetry.lock pyproject.toml .github` -> empty) -- pip-audit not re-run, nothing changed that could shift it; the LOW pip-audit finding on this range's parent ship verdict stands carried-forward, unaffected. No IaC file touched. No secret-pattern or private-key-header hit in this delta. No CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM finding.

findings.message: live_verdict_shas on a merge commit now includes the merged branch's own tip (the second parent) directly, not only its first parent.
findings.detail_md: CWE-284 (access-control-adjacent, informational). Verified this is the intended two-hop shape dd-gitflow-default already documents (PR head OR the head's first parent), now correctly reflected on the integration-branch side immediately after a merge -- not a new grant of trust. The walk is bounded to one hop from head_sha's direct parents; it cannot reach an older verdict deeper in git history. No corresponding weakening of the push-gate or doctor's stale-verdict enforcement was found on read.
findings.fix_recommendation: None required. Record only -- confirms the fix is scoped as claimed.
